title: In 1950, the U.S. Released a Bioweapon in San Francisco - Smithsonian Magazine
snippet: Smithsonian account of the 1950 Operation Sea-Spray bioweapon test.
quote: Beginning on September 26, 1950, the crew of a U.S. Navy minesweeper ship spent six days spraying Serratia marcescens into the air about two miles off the northern California coast. The project was called "Operation Sea Spray."
stance_why: Documents a secret large-scale open-air dispersal over a populated US city, supporting the claim's form as historically precedented.

title: Weather as a Force Multiplier: Owning the Weather in 2025. | National Technical Reports Library - NTIS
snippet: 1996 Air War College paper on military weather modification (NTIS ADA333462).
quote: The purpose of this paper is to outline a strategy for the use of a future weather modification system to achieve military objectives rather than to provide a detailed technical road map.
stance_why: US military paper stating institutional intent to develop weather-modification capabilities, supporting the skeptic's intent leg.
